_doc: Provenance for the GEBCO v2 seafloor assets (EARTH TWIN E2 v2). Written by scripts/gebco_seafloor_tiles.py — regenerate, never hand-edit. Any client wiring MUST surface attribution and the not-for-navigation disclaimer.

coverage.note: REGIONAL subset — everywhere outside this bbox has NO v2 data and renders transparent. Honest partial coverage, never fabricated global coverage.

tiling.depth_sampling: area-mean of covered cells per pixel (degenerates to containing cell at native zoom); no-coverage pixels encode elevation 0 (renders transparent under the depth ramp)
tiling.tid_sampling: nearest cell (categorical — never averaged); no-coverage pixels encode -1 (renders transparent)
